kinds.label: Channel
kinds.note: Minerva acts as the Slack app and reaches only channels the app has been added to in Slack (/invite and the app's name). Posting to channels shared with other organizations is refused.

operations.name: list_channels
operations.title: List channels
operations.description: List the Slack channels the app is in that you may read. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: read_channel
operations.title: Read a channel
operations.description: Read a channel's messages, newest first, optionally between two times. Replies in threads are not included; read_thread reads them. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor. Links to channels appear without the channel's name, and attachments (link previews, messages shared from other channels) are left out.

channel.description: A channel name such as "#general", or a channel id.

operations.name: read_thread
operations.title: Read a thread
operations.description: Read a thread in a channel, its first message first. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor. Links to channels appear without the channel's name, and attachments (link previews, messages shared from other channels) are left out.

channel.description: A channel name such as "#general", or a channel id.

thread.description: The ts of the thread's first message, or of any reply in it.

operations.name: post_message
operations.title: Post to a channel
operations.description: Post a new message to a channel where you have post permission. Text is shown literally: it cannot mention people or notify the channel, and may not link to Slack. Everyone in the channel sees it, posted as the Minerva app.

channel.description: A channel name such as "#general", or a channel id.

text.description: Slack mrkdwn (*bold*, _italic_, `code`, lists). Shown literally: no mentions or links with labels.

operations.name: reply
operations.title: Reply in a thread
operations.description: Reply in a thread of a channel where you have reply permission; the reply is not sent to the channel itself. Text is shown literally: it cannot mention people or notify the channel, and may not link to Slack. Everyone in the channel sees it, posted as the Minerva app.

channel.description: A channel name such as "#general", or a channel id.

thread.description: The ts of a message in this channel; replying to a reply joins its thread.

text.description: Slack mrkdwn (*bold*, _italic_, `code`, lists). Shown literally: no mentions or links with labels.
